components.purpose: Plain title and one-sentence intro at the top of the 'Compare us' page. Its guidance is a plain heading with optional subheading and description, no image or buttons, which fits. Hero was rejected as too heavy for a title and one sentence.

The feature-by-feature comparison with competitors. Its guidance is a heading, column names and ComparisonRow items for comparing options side by side across the same features. PricingTable was rejected because this is not a pricing comparison.
Closing call to action to book a demo. Its guidance is a full-width band with heading, description and buttons, used near the end of a page to push one action.
